That is why no `quote` field appears on any provenance record here: the Ontario builder re-reads its quotes to certify them, and a quote we may not store cannot be certified that way. authorizations.note: The certificate establishes that the holder is fit to hunt or trap. It is obtained by being a resident, being at least 12, and passing the initiation course matching the engin you will use — a firearm course for firearms, a bow-and-crossbow course for those. A Canadian citizen resident in Québec may obtain the firearm certificate without the course by producing an equivalent certificate or proof of competence from another Canadian province or territory.

authorizations.note: Annexe I sets the licence types; article 7 of that schedule is the small game licence, in resident and non-resident categories. A resident must hold a valid certificat du chasseur to be issued a resident licence — the small game licence is not one of the two the regulation exempts from that requirement.

orange.specification: A continuous fluorescent-orange surface of at least 2,580 cm², spread over the back, the shoulders and the chest, and visible at all times and from every angle. Fluorescent orange means a dominant wavelength between 595 and 605 nm, an excitation purity of at least 85%, and a minimum luminance factor of 40%.
orange.boundBeyondHunter: The same requirement binds any guide or other person accompanying the hunter.
orange.penalty: Contravening the requirement is an offence: a fine of $250 to $1,500 for a first offence, and $1,500 to $4,500 for a repeat within 5 years of conviction for an offence under the same provision.
unseeableExceptions: Bow or crossbow hunting in a sector reserved for the exclusive use of bow or crossbow in a wildlife reserve or a zec.
Hunting in a leased exclusive-rights sector where every hunter present uses a bow or crossbow.
Bow or crossbow hunting where only non-firearm engins are permitted.
Small game hunting with a bird of prey, where no participant is in possession of a weapon.
Beneficiaries of the James Bay and Northern Québec Agreement or the Northeastern Québec Agreement, within those agreements' territories.
